verdict.rationale: NVIDIA explicitly ships Isaac GR00T as an open reference VLA/foundation-model platform for robots, with generalization across grasping/manipulation tasks and multi-step skills, plus Isaac Lab and Isaac Sim providing the supported tooling pipeline (training, custom RL library integration, ROS 2 validation) to bring such models into a robot's autonomy stack. Community skepticism about GR00T demo speed reflects performance doubts, not a documented failure of the integration tooling itself. Missing for 10: independent third-party case studies confirming successful end-to-end VLA integration and deployment outcomes.
